# J's Bite

> Halal smashed-burger and crispy-chicken restaurant in Dahye – Rweis, Beirut, Lebanon. Dine In, Take Away, and Delivery. Order on WhatsApp +961 79 016 397.

## About
J's Bite serves 100% halal smashed beef burgers, crispy chicken burgers, wings, loaded fries, sandwiches, sides, dips, and cold drinks. Everything is made to order.

- Location: Dahye – Rweis, Beirut, Lebanon
- Hours: open every day, 1:00 PM – 2:00 AM
- Ordering: WhatsApp +961 79 016 397 (Dine In / Take Away / Delivery)
- Payment: Cash, USD
- Website: https://www.jsbite.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jsbitee/

## Menu highlights
- Offers: Family Chicken Meal ($30), Family Beef Meal ($40), Chicken Burger Combo ($13), Beef Burger Combo ($15), Chicken Burger Bundle ($10), Beef Burger Bundle ($12), Sandwich Combo ($12), Wings Offer ($15).
- Beef burgers ($8–$11): Classic Hero, Double Cheese, Swiss Mushroom, Truffle Royale, Mac 'n' Cheese, Smoky, J's Prime, Hulk Beef.
- Chicken burgers ($7–$8.50): Z Crunchy, BBQ, Sweet Bite, Chicken House, Spicy Storm, Zing Beast.
- Sandwiches ($5–$8): J Steak, Fajita, Crunchy Chicken, Francisco, Chicken Sub, J Steak Mushroom.
- Crispy chicken: 3 to 24 pcs ($5–$22).
- Appetizers: fries, wedges, mozzarella sticks, onion rings, jalapeno bites, wings, mac n cheese, loaded fries, loaded crispy.
- Dips ($0.60) and beverages ($1).

Full menu with current prices: https://www.jsbite.com/#menu
